svg.title: Controlled document placement in the multi-hop RAG benchmark
svg.desc: Each row has eleven documents. A1, A2, and A3 place a single gold document at the start, middle, or end. B1 and B2 cluster four gold documents in forward and reverse reasoning order. B3 shows one example of dispersed, randomised gold evidence.
svg.text: The diagnostic variable changes; the context budget does not.
B3 is one illustrative randomised placement, not a fixed sequence. Dots/grey blocks represent screened distractors.
